Three.js 0.170.0 (MIT; see THREE-LICENSE.txt)

three.module.js: https://unpkg.com/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.min.js
OrbitControls.js: https://unpkg.com/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js

OrbitControls' bare 'three' import is replaced with './three.module.js'.
These files are served locally and dynamically imported only when a trial is played.
